recommendations.text: Monitor for fall armyworm and other pests, especially in the irrigated plot (plot:003-2), which has shown good growth with recent favorable rainfall (rain:chiredzi:2026-09-d3).
Utilize the recent rainfall (rain:chiredzi:2026-09-d3) to support the growth of the irrigated plot (plot:003-2).
Given the stable price of sorghum (0.335 USD/kg) in Rutenga market (price:sorghum:rutenga:2026-09), the household should consider selling their sorghum when prices are favorable.
Continue to monitor soil moisture and adjust irrigation practices as needed for the irrigated plot (plot:003-2) to ensure optimal crop health.
